sloka: नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा ।प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.७५.१ ॥
transliteration: nāradasya tu tadvākyaṁ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṁ tadā ।praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 7.75.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, having heard those nectar-like words of Narada, Rama obtained immeasurable joy and spoke this to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: वासन्तिको निशा प्राप्ता शीता न च घर्मदा
